DLG-SC-LOC-031-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-031-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: まだ収穫を始めていないようですが、かごに何かありましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-031-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: It looks as though you haven't started harvesting yet. Was something wrong with the basket?

DLG-SC-LOC-031-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-031-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 底にひびがあって、持ち上げると広がります。実を入れる前に見ていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-031-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 空かごの底のひびが持ち上げると広がることを報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-031-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: There's a crack in the bottom, and it widens when I lift it. Could you look at it before I put fruit inside?
DLG-SC-LOC-031-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report that the crack in the empty basket's bottom widens when lifted. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-031-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-031-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 見せてください。このかごは使わず、空のままこちらに置きましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-031-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Show me. Let's not use this basket; put it here empty.

DLG-SC-LOC-031-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-031-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 使わないことが分かるよう、持ち手に札を付けてもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-031-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 使用中止の札をかごの持ち手に付けてよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-031-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: May I attach a tag to the handle so people know not to use it?
DLG-SC-LOC-031-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask whether you may attach an out-of-use tag to the basket handle. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-031-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-031-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その札を使ってください。代わりのかごを渡しますので、底と持ち手を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-031-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Use that tag. I'll give you a replacement basket, so let's check its bottom and handle.

DLG-SC-LOC-031-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-031-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: こちらはひびもぐらつきもありません。いっぱいに詰めずに運ぶ目安を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-031-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 交換かごの底と持ち手を点検し運ぶ量の目安を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-031-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: This one has no cracks or wobbling. Please tell me how much to carry rather than filling it completely.
DLG-SC-LOC-031-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Inspect the replacement basket's bottom and handle and ask for a guideline on the amount to carry. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-031-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-031-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 今日の作業では、この内側の線までにしてください。重く感じたら、線より少なくても構いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-031-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: For today's work, fill only to this line inside. If it feels heavy, less than the line is fine too.

DLG-SC-LOC-031-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-031-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 線に届く前でも、持ち上げて不安定なら量を減らします。運ぶ途中の置き場所はどこですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-031-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 不安定なら量を減らすと伝え途中の置き場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-031-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Even before it reaches the line, I'll reduce the amount if it feels unstable when lifted. Where can I set it down along the way?
DLG-SC-LOC-031-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will reduce the amount if unstable and ask where to set it down on the way. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-031-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-031-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 通路をふさがないこの台に置いてください。腰をひねって隣へ渡さず、一度台に載せましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-031-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Set it on this stand where it won't block the passage. Don't twist your waist to hand it to someone beside you; place it on the stand first.

DLG-SC-LOC-031-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-031-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: かごを確認し、運ぶ量を抑えて、受け渡しにはこの台を使います。割れたかごは修理担当に渡すまで残しますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-031-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 点検と少量運搬と台での受け渡しを確認し破損かごを残す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-031-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll check the basket, keep the load small, and use this stand for handovers. I'll keep the broken basket until it's handed to the repair person.
DLG-SC-LOC-031-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm inspection, small loads, and handovers using the stand, and retain the damaged basket. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-031-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-031-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、そのまま分けておいてください。確認してくれて助かりました、それでは気をつけて、失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-031-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes, keep it separate as it is. Thank you for checking; that helped. Take care, then. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-031-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-031-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの丸魚と切り身をご覧になっていますね。どんな料理に使われますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-031-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: You're looking at the whole fish and fillets. What will you cook?

DLG-SC-LOC-031-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-031-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 二人で煮魚を食べます。丸ごと一匹と切り身二枚では、食べる部分の量がずいぶん違いますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-031-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 二人分の煮魚として丸魚一匹と切り身二枚の可食量を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-031-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: We're having simmered fish for two. Is there a big difference in the edible amount between one whole fish and two fillets?
DLG-SC-LOC-031-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about edible quantities of one whole fish versus two fillets for simmered fish for two people. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-031-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-031-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 丸魚には頭や内臓の重さも含まれます。食べやすさを重視するなら、この切り身二枚から選べますよ。
DLG-SC-LOC-031-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: The whole fish's weight includes the head and innards. If ease of eating matters, you can choose these two fillets.

DLG-SC-LOC-031-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-031-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 二枚の厚みが違いますね。同じ鍋で煮たいので、近い厚みのものを探しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-031-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 同じ鍋で煮るため厚みの近い二枚を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-031-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: The two pieces have different thicknesses. I'd like to simmer them in the same pot, so I'm looking for ones of similar thickness.
DLG-SC-LOC-031-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask for two pieces of similar thickness to cook in the same pot. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-031-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-031-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらの組み合わせなら厚みが近いです。鍋はどのくらいの大きさですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-031-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: This combination has similar thicknesses. How large is your pot?

DLG-SC-LOC-031-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-031-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 直径二十センチです。重ねないで並べたいのですが、この二枚なら入りそうですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-031-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 二十センチの鍋に重ねず並べられるか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-031-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Twenty centimeters in diameter. I'd like to lay them side by side without overlapping. Do you think these two will fit?
DLG-SC-LOC-031-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check whether the two pieces fit without overlapping in a twenty-centimeter pot. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-031-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-031-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この二枚は端まで合わせると十八センチほどです。鍋の形によっては置き方を調整してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-031-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: These two together measure about eighteen centimeters from end to end. Adjust their placement according to the shape of the pot.

DLG-SC-LOC-031-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-031-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: それならこの組み合わせにします。皮に切れ目を入れる作業は家でしたほうがよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-031-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 選んだ切り身の皮に切れ目を入れる場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-031-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Then I'll choose this combination. Should I make slits in the skin at home?
DLG-SC-LOC-031-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask where to make slits in the skin of the selected fillets. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-031-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-031-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 切れ目を入れる下処理は、売場で対応できるか確認します。骨は残りますので、食べるときにも気をつけてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-031-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll check whether we can make the slits as preparation at this counter. Bones will remain, so take care when eating too.

DLG-SC-LOC-031-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-031-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 骨が残ることは家族にも伝えます。下処理ができるか確認してから、この二枚を買いたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-031-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 家族に骨が残ると伝え下処理の可否を確認して二枚を買う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-031-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll tell my family that bones remain. I'd like to buy these two after checking whether you can do that preparation.
DLG-SC-LOC-031-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will tell your family bones remain and buy the two pieces after checking preparation availability. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-031-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-031-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: かしこまりました、担当に確認できたらお包みします。それではお気をつけて、失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-031-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. I'll wrap them after confirming with the person responsible. Take care, then. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-031-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-031-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 温かいそばと冷たいそばで迷っていらっしゃいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-031-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you deciding between hot and cold soba?

DLG-SC-LOC-031-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-031-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 熱い汁を急いで飲むのが苦手です。冷たいそばでも、天ぷらを付けられますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-031-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 熱い汁が苦手と伝え冷たいそばに天ぷらを付けられるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-031-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'm not good at quickly drinking hot broth. Can I have tempura with cold soba too?
DLG-SC-LOC-031-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain difficulty with hot broth and ask whether tempura can accompany cold soba. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-031-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-031-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらの天ぷら付きのせいろがございます。天ぷらは別の皿でお出しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-031-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: We have this cold soba served on a tray with tempura. The tempura comes on a separate plate.

DLG-SC-LOC-031-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-031-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 別皿なら助かります。つゆに浸す前に、塩で食べることもできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-031-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 別皿の天ぷらをつゆに浸す前に塩で食べられるか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-031-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: A separate plate helps. Can I also eat it with salt before dipping it in the sauce?
DLG-SC-LOC-031-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can eat the separately served tempura with salt before dipping it. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-031-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-031-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 塩を添えることはできます。そばつゆも別の器なので、混ざらずに召し上がれます。
DLG-SC-LOC-031-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: We can provide salt. The soba dipping sauce is also in a separate bowl, so you can eat without mixing them.

DLG-SC-LOC-031-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-031-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では塩もお願いします。そばの量は普通盛りで、天ぷらは一人分で注文します。
DLG-SC-LOC-031-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 塩を追加して普通盛りと一人分の天ぷらを注文する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-031-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then salt too, please. I'll order a regular portion of soba and tempura for one person.
DLG-SC-LOC-031-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Add salt and order a regular soba portion with tempura for one. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-031-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-031-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 普通盛りの天ぷらせいろですね。食後のそば湯をご希望なら、お声をかけてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-031-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: A regular tempura soba tray, then. If you'd like soba cooking water after the meal, please let us know.

DLG-SC-LOC-031-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-031-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: そば湯は熱そうですね。今は頼まず、食べ終えてから温度を聞いて決めてもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-031-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: そば湯の注文は食後に温度を聞いてから決めたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-031-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: The soba cooking water sounds hot. May I leave it unordered now and decide after eating, once I've asked the temperature?
DLG-SC-LOC-031-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you want to decide about soba cooking water after the meal and after asking its temperature. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-031-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-031-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: もちろんです。お持ちする前に、熱さについてお伝えします。
DLG-SC-LOC-031-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Of course. We'll tell you how hot it is before bringing it.

DLG-SC-LOC-031-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-031-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日は冷たいそばをゆっくり食べて、そば湯は後で相談します。注文はそれでお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-031-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 冷たいそばの注文を確定しそば湯は後で相談すると確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-031-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Today I'll eat the cold soba slowly and ask about the cooking water later. That's my order, please.
DLG-SC-LOC-031-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the cold soba order and say you will discuss the cooking water later. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-031-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-031-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご注文を承りました、塩も忘れずに添えます。どうぞごゆっくり、失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-031-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Your order is taken, and we won't forget the salt. Please enjoy your time. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-031-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-031-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お持ちの通知についてでしょうか。上の見出しを確認させてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-031-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is this about the notice you're holding? Let me check the heading at the top.

DLG-SC-LOC-031-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-031-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: ここに相談先が二つ書いてあります。住民課に来ましたが、どちらが私の用件か分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-031-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 通知に相談先が二つあり住民課でよいか分からないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-031-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Two consultation contacts are listed here. I came to the residents' affairs section, but I don't know which one handles my matter.
DLG-SC-LOC-031-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say the notice lists two contacts and you are unsure whether the residents' affairs section is right. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-031-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-031-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この通知には保険の手続きが書かれていますので、住民課ではなく保険の担当へご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-031-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: This notice describes insurance procedures, so we'll guide you to the insurance staff rather than residents' affairs.

DLG-SC-LOC-031-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-031-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 保険の担当ですね。聞き間違えないよう、窓口の名前をこのメモに書いていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-031-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 保険担当の窓口名を聞き間違えないためメモへの記入を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-031-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: The insurance staff, then. To avoid mishearing, could you write the counter's name on this note?
DLG-SC-LOC-031-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask for the insurance counter's name to be written down so you do not mishear it. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-031-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-031-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 名前はこちらに書きます。案内図ではこの場所ですが、途中に同じ色の受付があるので番号も見てください。
DLG-SC-LOC-031-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll write the name here. It's at this spot on the map, but there's another reception of the same color along the way, so check the number too.

DLG-SC-LOC-031-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-031-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 色だけで判断せず番号を見ます。受付では、通知のどの部分を見せればよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-031-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 色ではなく受付番号を見て通知の見せる部分を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-031-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll look at the number rather than judging by color alone. Which part of the notice should I show at reception?
DLG-SC-LOC-031-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will check the counter number, not just color, and ask which part of the notice to show. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-031-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-031-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: まず見出しと相談先の部分を見せて、通知について相談したいと伝えてください。個人情報は必要に応じて担当者に見せましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-031-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: First show the heading and contact section, and say you want to ask about the notice. Show personal information to the staff member as needed.

DLG-SC-LOC-031-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-031-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 受付で全文を読み上げる必要はないのですね。詳しい話をするときは、ゆっくり説明してもらいたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-031-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 受付で全文を読まなくてよいか確かめゆっくりした説明を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-031-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: So I don't need to read the entire notice aloud at reception. When discussing the details, I'd like the explanation to be slow.
DLG-SC-LOC-031-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm you do not need to read the full notice at reception and request a slow explanation. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-031-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-031-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その希望も最初に伝えて構いません。通知と、この窓口名のメモをお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-031-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: You may say that at the beginning too. Please take the notice and this note with the counter name.

DLG-SC-LOC-031-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-031-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: メモと通知を一緒に持って、番号を確かめて行きます。保険の担当では、ゆっくり説明してほしいと伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-031-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 通知とメモを持ち番号を確認して保険担当へ向かうと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-031-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll bring the note and notice together and check the number as I go. At the insurance counter, I'll ask for a slow explanation.
DLG-SC-LOC-031-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will take the notice and note, check the number, and go to the insurance staff. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-031-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-031-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、案内図の印もご利用ください。それではお気をつけて、失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-031-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes, please use the mark on the map too. Take care, then. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-031-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-031-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: コピー機から出た紙をご覧になっていますが、何かお困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-031-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: You're looking at the paper from the copier. Is something wrong?

DLG-SC-LOC-031-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-031-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 横長の資料が縦の紙に小さく印刷されました。もう一枚出す前に、設定の場所を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-031-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 横長資料が縦用紙に縮小されたと伝え次の印刷設定を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-031-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: My landscape document was printed small on portrait paper. Before printing another sheet, please show me where the settings are.
DLG-SC-LOC-031-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say a landscape document was reduced onto portrait paper and ask about the next print settings. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-031-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-031-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ファイルの中身は見ずに、画面の設定だけご案内します。今は印刷方向の項目が表示されていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-031-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll guide you through the screen settings without looking at the file contents. Is the print orientation option displayed now?

DLG-SC-LOC-031-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-031-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 「自動」と表示されています。横向きを選ぶと、紙の向きも変わるのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-031-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 自動の印刷方向を横向きに変えたときの用紙配置を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-031-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: It says automatic. If I choose landscape, does the paper's orientation change too?
DLG-SC-LOC-031-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask about paper layout when changing automatic print orientation to landscape. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-031-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-031-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 横向きを選んだあと、プレビューで配置を確かめましょう。紙の大きさは今のものでよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-031-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: After selecting landscape, let's check the layout in the preview. Is the current paper size all right?

DLG-SC-LOC-031-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-031-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: Ａ４のままでよいです。下の小さな文字まで入るか、プレビューを拡大して見たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-031-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: Ａ４を保ち小さな文字が入るかプレビューを拡大して確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-031-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: A4 is fine. I'd like to enlarge the preview to see whether even the small text at the bottom fits.
DLG-SC-LOC-031-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Keep A4 and enlarge the preview to check the small text fits. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-031-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-031-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 拡大のボタンはこちらです。端が切れていたら、印刷を確定する前に用紙に合わせる設定も確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-031-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Here's the enlarge button. If the edges are cut off, also check the fit-to-paper setting before confirming printing.

DLG-SC-LOC-031-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-031-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 拡大すると端まで入っていました。試しに一部だけ出したいので、部数を一に戻します。
DLG-SC-LOC-031-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 端が欠けていないと確かめ試し刷りの部数を一に戻す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-031-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: After enlarging, I see it fits right to the edges. I'd like just one copy as a test, so I'll set the number of copies back to one.
DLG-SC-LOC-031-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check that the edges are not missing and reset the test-print quantity to one copy. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-031-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-031-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 部数が一になりましたね。料金の表示もご確認になってから、ご自身で開始ボタンを押してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-031-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: The quantity is one now. Check the displayed price too, then press the start button yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-031-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-031-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 料金を見て、一部だけ印刷します。終わったら元のファイルと紙を忘れずに持って帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-031-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 料金確認後に一部印刷しファイルと紙を持ち帰ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-031-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll check the price and print just one copy. Afterward I'll make sure to take the original file and paper home.
DLG-SC-LOC-031-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will print one copy after checking the price and take the file and paper home. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-031-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-031-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、お帰りの際は機械の周りもご確認ください。ご利用ありがとうございました、失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-031-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes, check around the machine when leaving too. Thank you for using it. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-031-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-031-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 申込書の氏名欄でお手が止まっていますね。表記についてのご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-031-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: You've paused at the name field on the application. Is this a question about how to write it?

DLG-SC-LOC-031-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-031-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 会社の書類は名字と名前の間に空白がありますが、在留カードとは並び方も違います。どちらを写すか確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-031-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 会社の書類と在留カードで氏名の空白と順番が違うと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-031-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: My company document has a space between my family and given names, and the order also differs from my residence card. I'd like to check which to copy.
DLG-SC-LOC-031-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that the spacing and order of your name differ between the company document and residence card. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-031-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-031-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どちらもお持ちですか。申込書に書く前に、本人確認書類の表記と会社の指定を担当者が確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-031-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you have both? Before you write the application, the staff member will check the identity document's spelling and the company's requirements.

DLG-SC-LOC-031-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-031-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 両方持っています。ここで私が順番を変えると、別の名前として登録されるのではないかと心配です。
DLG-SC-LOC-031-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 書類二種類を持参し自分で順番を変えて別名登録される不安を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-031-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have both. I'm worried that changing the order myself here might register me under a different name.
DLG-SC-LOC-031-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you brought both documents and are concerned changing the order yourself might lead to registration under a different name. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-031-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-031-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ご自身の判断で変えず、その違いを担当者に伝えましょう。カタカナの欄にも迷っていらっしゃいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-031-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Don't change it on your own judgment; tell the staff member about the difference. Are you unsure about the katakana field too?

DLG-SC-LOC-031-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-031-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい、名前の最後の音が会社の書類では長音になっています。読み方を口で伝えてから書けますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-031-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 会社書類の長音表記と実際の読みを口で伝えてから記入したいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-031-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. The final sound of my name is written as a long vowel on the company document. May I explain the pronunciation aloud before writing?
DLG-SC-LOC-031-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask to explain the actual pronunciation aloud before writing, noting the company's long-vowel spelling. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-031-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-031-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 読み方を聞いて確認できます。会社が給与振込に使う表記も確認する必要がありますので、その書類は残しておいてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-031-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: We can listen and check. We also need to confirm the spelling the company uses for salary transfers, so please keep that document.

DLG-SC-LOC-031-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-031-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 会社に問い合わせる場合、今ここで口座ができるかはまだ分からないということですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-031-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 会社への問い合わせがあれば即日開設の可否は未定と確かめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-031-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: If you need to inquire with the company, whether an account can be opened here now is still unknown, correct?
DLG-SC-LOC-031-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm that immediate account opening remains uncertain if a company inquiry is needed. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-031-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-031-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、氏名の確認以外にも申込みの確認があります。今日中の開設はお約束できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-031-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Correct. There are application checks besides the name check too. We cannot promise opening the account today.

DLG-SC-LOC-031-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-031-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 提出期限があるので、会社には氏名の確認中と連絡します。申込書は担当者に確認してもらってから記入します。
DLG-SC-LOC-031-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 会社に氏名確認中と連絡し担当者の確認後に申込書を書くと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-031-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: There's a submission deadline, so I'll tell the company my name is being checked. I'll fill out the application after the staff member has checked it.
DLG-SC-LOC-031-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will tell the company the name is being checked and fill the application after staff confirmation. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-031-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-031-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました、書類をそろえたまま次の担当へお進みください。本日はご相談ありがとうございました、失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-031-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Keep your documents together and proceed to the next staff member. Thank you for consulting us today. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-032-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-032-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 城内をご案内しますが、階段のある区間も含まれます。
DLG-SC-032-001-SHARED-01.translation: I'll guide you around the castle, but the route includes sections with stairs.

DLG-SC-032-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-032-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 膝が痛くて階段を登れません。平らな所で石垣の説明を聞けますか。
DLG-SC-032-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 膝の痛みを伝えて平地で石垣の説明を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-032-001-SHARED-02.translation: My knee hurts and I can't climb stairs. Can I hear the explanation of the stone walls on level ground?
DLG-SC-032-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain your knee pain and request the stone-wall explanation on level ground. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-032-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-032-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: それなら、ここにある案内図で石垣の見える場所を選びましょう。
DLG-SC-032-001-SHARED-03.translation: Then let's use this map to choose a place where the stone walls are visible.

DLG-SC-032-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-032-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この黒い線は坂ですか、それとも階段ですか。
DLG-SC-032-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 案内図の黒線が坂か階段か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-032-001-SHARED-04.translation: Is this black line a slope or stairs?
DLG-SC-032-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask whether the black line on the map means a slope or stairs. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-032-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-032-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 階段の印ですね。坂は斜線なので、この印のある道は避けてください。
DLG-SC-032-001-SHARED-05.translation: It's the stair symbol. Slopes use diagonal lines, so avoid the paths with this symbol.

DLG-SC-032-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-032-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 階段を避けると、石垣の角までどちら側から回れますか。
DLG-SC-032-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 階段を避けて石垣の角へ回る方向を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-032-001-SHARED-06.translation: Which side can I go around from to reach the stone-wall corner without stairs?
DLG-SC-032-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask which direction reaches the stone-wall corner while avoiding stairs. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-032-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-032-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 図では右側の道がつながっていますが、今日の通行状況は入口で確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-032-001-SHARED-07.translation: The right-hand path connects on the map, but let's check today's access conditions at the entrance.

DLG-SC-032-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-032-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 入口で確認する間、同行者とここで待っていてもいいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-032-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 通行確認中に同行者と待つ場所を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-032-001-SHARED-08.translation: May I wait here with my companion while you check at the entrance?
DLG-SC-032-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask where you and your companion can wait during the access check. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-032-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-032-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 通路をふさがないよう、そちらのベンチへどうぞ。
DLG-SC-032-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please use that bench so you don't block the passage.

DLG-SC-032-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-032-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ではベンチで待ちます。通れると分かってから右側の道へ進みます。
DLG-SC-032-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: ベンチで待って通行確認後に右側へ進むと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-032-001-SHARED-10.translation: Then I'll wait on the bench. I'll take the right-hand path after it's confirmed passable.
DLG-SC-032-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will wait on the bench and take the right-hand path after access is confirmed. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-032-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-032-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 入口で確認してきますので、どうぞ少しお休みください。
DLG-SC-032-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll check at the entrance, so please rest a little.

DLG-SC-LOC-032-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-032-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 台所の柱を熱心にご覧になっていますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-032-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: You're looking closely at the kitchen pillars.

DLG-SC-LOC-032-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-032-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 柱が黒いのは、火事の跡でしょうか。ほかの部屋より色が濃いですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-032-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 台所の黒い柱が火事の跡か質問する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-032-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Are the black pillars traces of a fire? They're darker than in the other rooms.
DLG-SC-LOC-032-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether the black kitchen pillars are traces of a fire. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-032-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-032-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この説明板では、囲炉裏の煙によるすすと紹介しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-032-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: This explanation board describes it as soot from smoke from the sunken hearth.

DLG-SC-LOC-032-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-032-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 囲炉裏というのは、この床の四角い所のことですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-032-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 囲炉裏が床の四角い部分か確かめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-032-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Does the sunken hearth mean this square part of the floor?
DLG-SC-LOC-032-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Check whether the hearth is the square part of the floor. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-032-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-032-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい、その部分です。火を使った暮らしを想像できるよう、道具も置いてあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-032-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes, that part. Tools are also placed here to help you imagine life using fire.

DLG-SC-LOC-032-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-032-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 上につるしてある鍋は、どうやって高さを変えたのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-032-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: つるした鍋の高さを変える仕組みを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-032-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: How did they adjust the height of the pot hanging above it?
DLG-SC-LOC-032-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask how the hanging pot's height was adjusted. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-032-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-032-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この模型で仕組みを説明できます。実物には手を触れないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-032-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: I can explain the mechanism with this model. Please don't touch the original object.

DLG-SC-LOC-032-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-032-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 模型を見たいです。先に柱と囲炉裏を一枚のスケッチにしてもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-032-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 模型を見る前に柱と囲炉裏をスケッチしたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-032-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'd like to see the model. May I first sketch the pillar and hearth together in one drawing?
DLG-SC-LOC-032-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you want to sketch the pillar and hearth before seeing the model. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-032-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-032-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: スケッチは構いませんが、入口を空けて描いてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-032-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Sketching is fine, but please keep the entrance clear while drawing.

DLG-SC-LOC-032-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-032-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 入口から離れて描きます。描き終えたら、模型の説明をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-032-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 入口を空けて描いた後に模型の説明を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-032-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll move away from the entrance to draw. After I finish, please explain the model.
DLG-SC-LOC-032-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask for the model explanation after drawing away from the entrance. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-032-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-032-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その頃に模型をお見せしますね。ごゆっくりどうぞ。
DLG-SC-LOC-032-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll show you the model then. Please take your time.

DLG-SC-LOC-032-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-032-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 茶葉とティーバッグを並べていますが、どちらをお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-032-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: We have loose tea and tea bags displayed. Which are you looking for?

DLG-SC-LOC-032-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-032-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 職場で飲むお茶を買いたいです。急須がないので、マグカップだけで入れられる物はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-032-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 急須のない職場向けにカップで入れられるお茶を探す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-032-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to buy tea to drink at work. There's no teapot, so is there something I can make using only a mug?
DLG-SC-LOC-032-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Look for tea that can be made in a cup at a workplace without a teapot. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-032-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-032-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: それでしたら、こちらのティーバッグが候補になります。
DLG-SC-LOC-032-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: In that case, these tea bags are an option.

DLG-SC-LOC-032-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-032-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 一袋で大きなマグカップ一杯分を作れるか、箱を見て確かめたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-032-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 一袋で大きなマグ一杯を作れるか表示を確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-032-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'd like to check the box to see whether one bag makes a full large mug.
DLG-SC-LOC-032-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you want to check the label for whether one tea bag makes a large mugful. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-032-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-032-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この箱には一袋に対する湯の量が書いてあります。お使いのカップは何ミリリットルですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-032-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: This box states the amount of hot water per bag. How many milliliters does your cup hold?

DLG-SC-LOC-032-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-032-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: カップは三百ミリリットルです。この表示より多いので、味が薄くなりそうですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-032-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 三百ミリリットルのカップと表示量の差を指摘する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-032-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: My cup holds three hundred milliliters. That's more than the label, so the flavor may be weak.
DLG-SC-LOC-032-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Point out the difference between your three-hundred-milliliter cup and the labeled amount. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-032-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-032-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 濃さの好みもありますが、まず表示どおりの量で試してみてはいかがですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-032-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Strength depends on preference too, but how about first trying the amount stated on the label?

DLG-SC-LOC-032-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-032-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: では湯を少なめにして試します。開けた袋を職場で保管するには何に注意すればいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-032-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 湯を減らして試すと伝え開封後の職場での保管を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-032-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Then I'll try with less hot water. What should I watch out for when storing the opened bag at work?
DLG-SC-LOC-032-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will try less water and ask about workplace storage after opening. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-032-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-032-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらには密封して湿気を避けると記載されています。小さい箱もありますよ。
DLG-SC-LOC-032-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: It says here to seal it and avoid moisture. We have small boxes too.

DLG-SC-LOC-032-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-032-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 保管場所が狭いので、小さい箱を一つ買います。袋の口を閉じる道具も用意します。
DLG-SC-LOC-032-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 狭い保管場所に合わせ小さい箱一つを選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-032-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Storage space is limited, so I'll buy one small box. I'll also prepare something to close the bag opening.
DLG-SC-LOC-032-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Choose one small box to suit your limited storage space. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-032-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-032-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: こちらの小さい箱ですね。お会計へどうぞ、ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-032-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: This small box, then. Please come to the checkout. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-032-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-032-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 冷たいそばと温かいそばがあります。どちらになさいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-032-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: We have cold and hot soba. Which would you like?

DLG-SC-LOC-032-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-032-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 同行者は冷たいそばが好きですが、私は途中で体が冷えそうです。温かい物も一緒に頼めますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-032-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 冷たいそばと一緒に温かい料理を頼めるか相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-032-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: My companion likes cold soba, but I think I may get cold partway through. Can I order a hot dish alongside it?
DLG-SC-LOC-032-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether a hot dish can be ordered together with cold soba. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-032-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-032-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 温かいそばを別に頼むことはできますが、冷たいそばを途中で作り直す注文は受けていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-032-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: You can order hot soba separately, but we don't accept orders to remake cold soba partway through the meal.

DLG-SC-LOC-032-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-032-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 作り直しは頼まないので、小さい温かいそばがあるか教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-032-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 作り直しを求めず小さい温かいそばの有無を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-032-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I won't ask for it to be remade. Please tell me whether there's a small hot soba.
DLG-SC-LOC-032-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Do not request remaking; ask whether a small hot soba is available. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-032-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-032-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 今日のメニューには小さいサイズがありません。通常の一杯になります。
DLG-SC-LOC-032-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Today's menu has no small size. It would be a regular bowl.

DLG-SC-LOC-032-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-032-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: それなら私は温かいそばにします。同行者の冷たいそばと同じ時に出してもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-032-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 温かいそばを選び同行者の注文との同時提供を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-032-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then I'll have hot soba. Can you serve it at the same time as my companion's cold soba?
DLG-SC-LOC-032-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Choose hot soba and request simultaneous service with your companion's order. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-032-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-032-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 調理時間が違うため、同時に出せるか厨房で相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-032-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: The cooking times differ, so I'll ask the kitchen whether they can be served together.

DLG-SC-LOC-032-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-032-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 少しずれても構いません。先に来た方から食べ始めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-032-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 提供がずれても先に届いた料理から食べると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-032-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: It's all right if they're a little apart. We'll start eating whichever arrives first.
DLG-SC-LOC-032-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will start with whichever dish arrives first even if serving times differ. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-032-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-032-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 承知しました。温かいそば一つ、冷たいそば一つでよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-032-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. One hot soba and one cold soba, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-032-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-032-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: その二つでお願いします。温かい方は私の席に置いてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-032-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 二つの注文を確定して温かいそばの配膳先を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-032-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Those two, please. Put the hot one at my seat.
DLG-SC-LOC-032-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm both orders and say where to serve the hot soba. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-032-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-032-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: かしこまりました。出来上がるまで、ごゆっくりお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-032-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. Please relax while waiting for them to be ready.
